messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor about all your medical conditions.
Tell your doctor about all your medications.
Do this before starting fluoxetine (Prozac).
Some medical conditions may interact with fluoxetine.
Some medications may interact with fluoxetine.
Some conditions or medications may affect whether fluoxetine is safe for you.
Tell your doctor if you take any of the following medications or supplements:
Triptans (for migraine)
Antidepressants or mood stabilizers, including SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclics, MAOIs, lithium, buspirone, or antipsychotics
Amphetamines
Opioid pain medications, including tramadol, fentanyl, meperidine, or methadone
Over-the-counter supplements such as St. John's Wort or tryptophan
Electroconvulsive therapy (ECT)
Many of these combinations can increase the risk of serotonin syndrome.
Serotonin syndrome is a potentially serious condition.
Tell your doctor if you have or have had any of the following:
Liver, kidney, or heart problems
Seizures or epilepsy
Bipolar disorder or mania
Low sodium levels in the blood
A stroke or high blood pressure
Bleeding problems
Pregnancy
Triplet: ["serotonin syndrome", "is", "potentially serious condition"]

The relation 'is' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is classified or defined as the entity specified by the object.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
B. 'include': The object entity is a type or example of the subject entity.
C. 'contribute to': The subject entity plays a role in the development or occurrence of the object entity.
D. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
E. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
